description: Search recent news articles with AgentSearch and return them as JSON text: title, URL, snippet, domain and publish date. Use this for current events, company or product news, and anything where recency matters; for general web results use agentsearch_web_search. Free, no wallet: this remote server uses the AgentSearch free relay. Free allowance: 10 news searches per IP in total (lifetime, does not reset), then pay per call ($0.003). Read-only: not destructive, but it uses the network.

max_results.description: How many articles to return (1-10, default 5).

query.description: News topic, company, person or event (at least 2 characters).

name: agentsearch_news_search
title: AgentSearch News Search
